elements.requirement: The local housing authority may from time to time serve a notice on the occupier of premises subject to an operative overcrowding notice requiring that occupier to furnish a written statement within seven days with specified particulars.
elements.quote: The local housing authority may from time to time serve on the occupier of premises in respect of which an overcrowding notice is in force a notice requiring him to furnish them within seven days with a statement in writing

elements.requirement: The occupier of the premises may be required to furnish a statement giving the number of individuals who are occupying any part of the premises as sleeping accommodation on a date specified in the notice.
elements.quote: the number of individuals who are, on a date specified in the notice, occupying any part of the premises as sleeping accommodation

elements.requirement: The occupier of the premises may be required to furnish a statement giving the number of families or households to which the occupying individuals belong.
elements.quote: the number of families or households to which those individuals belong

elements.requirement: The occupier of the premises may be required to furnish a statement giving the names of the occupying individuals and of the heads of each of those families or households.
elements.quote: the names of those individuals and of the heads of each of those families or households

elements.requirement: The occupier of the premises may be required to furnish a statement giving the rooms used by the occupying individuals and families or households respectively.
elements.quote: the rooms used by those individuals and families or households respectively

elements.requirement: A person who knowingly fails to comply with the requirements of a notice served under this section commits a summary offence.
elements.quote: knowingly fails to comply with the requirements of such a notice, or (b) furnishes a statement which he knows to be false in a material particular, commits a summary offence

elements.requirement: A person convicted of knowingly failing to comply with the requirements of the notice is liable to a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.
elements.quote: liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding , in the case of such failure, level 3 on the standard scale

elements.requirement: A person who furnishes a statement which they know to be false in a material particular commits a summary offence.
elements.quote: furnishes a statement which he knows to be false in a material particular, commits a summary offence

elements.requirement: A person convicted of furnishing a statement known to be false in a material particular is liable to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.
elements.quote: in the case of furnishing such a statement, level 5 on the standard scale

thresholds.what: maximum fine level on the standard scale for furnishing a statement known to be false in a material particular
thresholds.quote: in the case of furnishing such a statement, level 5 on the standard scale
